title: Immune deficiency disorders, excluding HIV
summary: Immune deficiency disorder (excluding HIV) with one of: documented hospital admissions for infection, repeated infections requiring intervention, OR repeated manifestations with constitutional symptoms and marked functional limitation.

children.criterion: Three documented infections requiring hospitalization for ≥48 hours each, occurring within a 12-month period
Three documented infections requiring hospitalization within 12 months
Each hospitalization lasting at least 48 hours
Stem cell transplantation (claimant disabled for at least 12 months from date of transplantation)
Repeated manifestations with constitutional symptoms AND marked limitation
Repeated manifestations of immune deficiency disorder
Marked limitation in ADLs, social functioning, or concentration/persistence/pace
